name: Tempo — stewardship cadence
summary: Finds the monitoring cadence that balances the cost of acting too early against the cost of acting too late.

reconciliation.note: The StewardshipTempo Lean source behind DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20705183 is not in this repository; the function stays callable preview-only until the source is deposited here and its hash is recorded.

inputs.name: haste_cost
inputs.help: Cost of visiting or intervening too often (per cycle).

inputs.name: neglect_cost
inputs.help: Cost of waiting too long between visits (per cycle).

inputs.name: cadence
inputs.help: Your current interval between visits (time units).

hypotheses.statement: Haste and neglect costs are positive.

scope: Deterministic theorem-backed computation; empirical input validity is external.
boundary: Thresholds remain conditional on supplied coefficients, observation models, uncertainty moments, and declared switching costs. The result is conditional on the supplied inputs; it does not establish empirical validity, Viridis review, certification, a credit, or a registry determination.
